heading: Tonight
text: Any showers tapering off north to south, with gradual clearing. Cool. Lows in the 40s to near 50 in the south. Light northwest wind.

heading: Saturday
text: Mixed clouds in the morning, with more sunshine developing throughout the day. Highs in the upper 50s to low 60s north, in the 60s south. Light north wind.

heading: Saturday Night
text: Mostly clear. Areas of valley fog, and some frost possible in the cold spots. Lows in the 30s to low 40s. Wind becoming light and variable.
